a: Content Security Policy restricts which scripts and resources can load.
SRI ensures third-party scripts match expected hashes.
HttpOnly cookies are not accessible to JavaScript.
Secure cookies are only sent over HTTPS.
SameSite cookie attributes help mitigate CSRF.
Validate redirect URLs to prevent open redirect attacks.
Mass assignment binds extra fields from input; whitelist fields.
Validate type/size and store uploads outside the web root.
Never log passwords, tokens, or full card numbers.
Report vulnerabilities privately to maintainers when possible.
